title: Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints (SIFT)
annotation: Makalah kanonikal paling berpengaruh dalam visi komputer yang memperkenalkan detektor Difference-of-Gaussians, orientasi kanonikal, deskriptor 128D invarian skala, dan Lowe's Ratio Test.

title: ORB: An Efficient Alternative to SIFT or SURF
authors: Ethan Rublee, Vincent Rabaud, Kurt Konolige, Gary Bradski
publisher: IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV), 2564-2571
annotation: Memperkenalkan Oriented FAST and Rotated BRIEF, deskriptor biner 256-bit bebas paten berkecepatan komputasi hingga ratusan kali lebih cepat dibandingkan SIFT untuk edge computing.

title: Random Sample Consensus: A Paradigm for Model Fitting with Applications to Image Analysis
authors: Martin A. Fischler, Robert C. Bolles
annotation: Makalah dasar penemu algoritma RANSAC, metodologi estimasi parameter model matematis yang tangguh terhadap keberadaan data pencilan (outliers) ekstrem.

title: A Combined Corner and Edge Detector
publisher: Proceedings of the 4th Alvey Vision Conference, 147-151
annotation: Formulasi dasar fungsi respon sudut Harris berbasis autokorelasi lokal dan penghindaran komputasi eigenvalue langsung.
